what_to_detect: A decision candidate casting a creature spell through its Mutate cost has a legal target (a non-Human creature with the same owner as the spell) and is playable.
near_miss: A Mutate-cost candidate with no legal target, because no non-Human creature with the spell's owner is on the battlefield.
record_fields: candidates[].ability (the Mutate keyword line: script_api_type Keyword, keyword_display_name Mutate)

what_to_detect: A spell cast through its Mutate cost whose target is illegal as it resolves resolves as an ordinary creature spell: its effect half moves it from the stack to the battlefield.
near_miss: A Mutate-cast spell whose target is still legal merges with it: it moves from the stack to the merged zone, not the battlefield.
record_fields: resolution effect half zone_change from_zone stack, to_zone battlefield or merged
acting line: the Mutate keyword line (script_api_type Keyword, so api cannot select it; keyword_display_name can)
cost half outcome (resolved rather than fizzled)

what_to_detect: A mutated permanent has the abilities of every card merged into it and the other characteristics (name, types, colours, power and toughness) of its top card.
near_miss: A creature that is not mutated has only its own abilities and characteristics.
record_fields: snapshot entity keywords, types, colours and power/toughness

what_to_detect: An effect that applied to a mutating creature spell applies to the mutated permanent it merged with.
near_miss: A mutated permanent whose mutating spell no such effect applied to lacks that effect.
